text_block_list.text:
And just like that, the 4th Live was over 
in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, thank you very much for 
coming today.

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text:
It was amazing~! Thank YOU so much~! Do 
your best at the Grand Live, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...... Yes, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka stood on the stage for a 
while, listening to the cheers of the 
crowd.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I shall be heading back ahead 
of you. I need you to measure the pulse 
rates of every single Umamusume in 
attendance immediately.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
choice_data_list: What is it you want to prove?
What is it that you want to prove?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Who knows?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...If I had to put it in words, a "wish," 
perhaps.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I hope the cheers of the fans heard 
during the concert gave <chrname> strength as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having heard about the Grand Live and 
participating in it, I hope her own 
heartfelt wishes are fulfilled on that 
stage.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...Perhaps wishing for that to be true is 
simply my own personal desire as someone 
cheering her on.
"...-ner...! ...Trainer!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer? Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, I know you're busy, but there's 
one thing I really need to speak with you 
about.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm thinking of speaking with the academy 
soon to hold an "Information Session for 
the Grand Live."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Through the promotional lives with 
everyone, the number of Umamusume willing 
to help has grown. And thanks to that, our 
fans have multiplied by a ton too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"...That is precisely why we must 
sincerely confront these lingering ill 
feelings."

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
There are people I must provide a 
satisfying explanation to regarding the 
Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The Academy's Umamusume, and the URA 
Board of Directors.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
While continuing to petition the board of 
directors, I decided that I must first 
deliver my message directly to the 
academy's students myself.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Wishing for a live concert for both the 
Umamusume and the fans, ...as a fan 
myself.
choice_data_list: I'll try consulting Chairwoman Akikawa too

I'll try consulting Chairwoman Akikawa 
too.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Oh no, don't say that. You've already 
helped me so much, Trainer. To burden you 
any further would be—
choice_data_list: I'm a fan too, so I want to help
I'm a fan too, so I want to help out.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, I look forward to working 
with you. Please stay with me until the 
very end!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And later, she went to the Academy 
Chairwoman's office with Light Hello and 
received permission to hold an orientation 
for the Grand Live.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everything is for the sake of holding the 
Grand Live. Let's continue to support the 
girls with all our might!
